summary: Perflutren has received the strongest level of warning from the FDA, known as a boxed warning, regarding heart harm and serious cardiopulmonary reactions affecting the heart and lungs that can rarely be fatal [3][4]. The label also notes warnings for serious allergic reactions, and most severe issues happen within 30 minutes of taking the drug [4]. Meanwhile, a small computer model rather than human testing estimated low risk scores of 12 for the liver and 10 for the heart [M].
